league.name: Legacy League Golf
league.mission: A city-based celebrity team golf league with a mental health mission.

cities.name: Chicago
cities.story: Chicago plays for the fans who stayed. Bears, Bulls, Cubs, White Sox and Blackhawks legends share one bag, one city and one cause: Mind Forward Foundation, which the team funds with every point it scores.

cities.name: Boston
cities.story: Boston plays for the fans who stayed. Celtics, Red Sox, Patriots and Bruins legends share one bag, one city and one cause: The Quiet Room Project, which the team funds with every point it scores.

cities.name: New York
cities.story: New York plays for the fans who stayed. Yankees, Knicks, Giants, Jets, Mets and Rangers legends share one bag, one city and one cause: Open Fairways Mental Health Fund, which the team funds with every point it scores.

stories.author: Legacy League
stories.title: Jonathan Schecter named Chief Product Officer
stories.dek: He led the build of the fan platform you are reading this on: website, apps and live scoring, from brief to Mayakoba in ten weeks. Now he owns the product roadmap for all eighteen markets.

stories.title: Ingram's eagle on 13, from three angles
stories.dek: The captain had not made an eagle since Del Mar. Then he hit a 5-wood to six feet.

stories.author: Legacy League
stories.title: Round 1 recap: Dallas lead a bunched field at −17
stories.dek: Five cities inside four shots. Chicago's back nine of −9 was the round of the day; Miami lost two balls to the wind on 16 and never recovered.
